maddeler.e:
أللت (form I)
# أَلَلْتُ (ʔalaltu) /ʔa.lal.tu/: first-person singular past active of أَلَّ (ʔalla)
# أَلَلْتَ (ʔalalta) /ʔa.lal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of أَلَّ (ʔalla)
# أَلَلْتِ (ʔalalti) /ʔa.lal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of أَلَّ (ʔalla)
# أُلِلْتُ (ʔuliltu) /ʔu.lil.tu/: first-person singular past passive of أَلَّ (ʔalla)
# أُلِلْتَ (ʔulilta) /ʔu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
